点击登录后，在佳明官方页面输入账号、密码和验证码。软件仅保存可续期的授权令牌，不: Sign in on the official Garmin page with your account, password and verification code. Only renewable authorization tokens are saved, never your password. Choose how to upload in Sync records.
先确认下方关联设备与你的手表一致，再到同步记录选择手动或自动上传。退出账户会停止: Check that the linked device below matches your watch, then choose manual or automatic uploading in Sync records. Signing out stops access to that account; original local files are kept.
蓝牙用于查找你选择的手表、接收实时指标和原始文件。点击下方连接按钮后，macOS: Bluetooth finds your chosen watch and receives live readings and original files. macOS requests permission only after you click a connection button below. Choose Allow.
已允许本机访问蓝牙。只连接你选择的手表；可随时断开或在系统设置中关闭访问。: Bluetooth is allowed on this Mac. Only your chosen watch is connected. You can disconnect or revoke access in System Settings at any time.
系统权限已允许，但尚未开始扫描或连接。准备好后，再点击下方按钮。: System access is allowed, but scanning and connecting have not started. Click a button below when you are ready.
请打开“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 蓝牙”，允许 WristBeam 访问，: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Bluetooth and allow WristBeam, then return here and retry. You can still sign in to a device account to view cloud records.
此 Mac 的系统策略限制了蓝牙访问。请联系设备管理员；你仍可使用设备账号和原始: A system policy restricts Bluetooth on this Mac. Contact the device administrator. Device accounts and original FIT import remain available.
Mac 蓝牙当前关闭。请在系统蓝牙设置中开启，再返回此页连接。: Bluetooth is off on this Mac. Turn it on in System Settings, then return here to connect.
启动时连接已配对手表: Connect to the saved watch at launch
默认关闭。完成授权和首次配对后，可主动开启；以后启动只恢复已保存的手表，不会弹出: Off by default. After granting access and pairing, you can enable it. Future launches restore only your saved watch and never request first-time permission.
只恢复本次主动建立的连接。手动断开后停止重连；关闭主窗口仍在菜单栏运行，退出应用: Only a connection you started in this session is restored. Manual disconnect stops retries. Closing the main window keeps the menu bar app running; quitting or Mac sleep pauses syncing.
打开软件不会自动申请蓝牙或连接手表。按下面的顺序设置，完成后即可在菜单栏和浮窗查: Opening the app does not request Bluetooth access or connect a watch automatically. Follow these steps to see your data in the menu bar and floating panel.
实时指标保存在本机。上传云端的是手表生成的原始运动与健康 FIT，目标为你在设备: Live readings stay on this Mac. Cloud uploads contain original activity and health FIT files generated by your watch, sent to the region and account selected in Device account. New installations default to manual sync.
请先连接手表绑定的设备账号: Connect the account linked to your watch first
开启后，新收到的文件自动进入队列并上传，失败会保留重试。关闭后停止自动上传，仍可: When enabled, newly received files are queued and uploaded automatically, with failures kept for retry. Turn it off to pause automatic uploads; Sync now remains available and no local files are deleted.
通道就绪后，在设备账号登录同一账户，再选择手动或自动同步。: Once the channels are ready, sign in to the same account in Device account and choose manual or automatic syncing.
检查只查询 GitHub 的版本信息。升级按“查看版本 → 确认下载 → 校验并: Checking only queries release information from GitHub. Upgrades follow Review release → Confirm download → Validate and restart. Wait for active sync tasks to finish before installing.
只选择手表生成的原始 FIT。文件加入本地队列；自动同步开启后上传到当前设备账号: Select only original FIT files generated by your watch. They enter the local queue. Automatic sync uploads them to the current device account; otherwise they wait for manual sync.
只监测你选择的文件夹，将新增 FIT 加入本地队列。自动同步开启后上传到当前设备: Only the selected folder is monitored. New FIT files enter the local queue and upload to the current device account when automatic sync is enabled. Stop monitoring at any time in Sync records.

允许持有密钥的客户端读取已缓存的健康指标、时间序列和同步状态。不会提供账号凭据、: Clients with your key can read cached health metrics, time series and sync status. Account credentials, device identifiers, original FIT files and watch control are excluded.
局域网客户端也能读取健康数据。证书须覆盖访问地址，且客户端必须信任证书。: Network clients can also read health data. The certificate must cover this address and be trusted by the client.
请导入含私钥的 .p12 / .pfx 证书: Import a .p12 / .pfx certificate with its private key
支持手动 Bearer 密钥的 Streamable HTTP 客户端；不提供: Use a Streamable HTTP client with a manual Bearer key. OAuth login is not provided. Configuration varies by AI client.
开启后，将所选健康指标与同步状态发送到下方地址。目标服务会获得这些数据，请只填写: When enabled, selected health metrics and sync status are sent to this address. Only use a receiver you trust with this data.
HMAC-SHA256 签名；不跟随重定向，失败最多尝试三次。未投递快照不跨退出: HMAC-SHA256 signatures. No redirects; up to three attempts. Pending snapshots are not retained after quit.
